Explicit drive converged=1 at all solved steps; bounded PD and both reset replay cases converged=0, iterations=200. Initial undefined status excluded. Frozen 1e-7 residual tolerances remain unchanged; physical/reference gates are separate.

All 8 reset runs: control effort/position-target/velocity-target arrays byte-value identical before/after reset; replay explicitly sets controls afterward. All four paired body/joint fields have max_abs=0.
Explicit 0%, 200 iterations, terminal r_c=4.4e-7 J now present in experiments, implementation, version notes.
sparse_jacobian=True and LLTBRCM are backend defaults; DVI preconditioning=False is validation requirement. Full four-field configuration-group difference remains disclosed.

config.fk.reset_state selects reference versus current pose as initial guess (config.py:1004); both variants write solved body/joint poses via public FromActuatorQ reset. Six ordered non-singular targets, not a write-back switch or dynamic tracking. Analytic max position errors 5.314e-8 / 1.893e-7 m below 1e-5 m gate.

New local evidence links describe bounded-drive output and backend residual/trajectory observations, explicitly not proof of isolated kernels, full paper reproduction, or performance ranking. Existing paper equations were not independently rederived in this final publication review.

findings.issue: Published drive success lacked concrete 0% converged / 200-iteration diagnostic.
findings.resolution: Generator now adds bounded-PD 0%, 200, terminal r_c=4.4e-7 J and explicitly separates physical acceptance from convergence.

findings.issue: Backend-dependent defaults had been described collectively as necessary settings.
findings.resolution: Publication distinguishes default Jacobian/linear-solver choices from DVI mandatory disabled preconditioning.

remaining_experiment_gaps.specific: Singular configurations, multiple assembly branches, failed-target success_mask, perturbed/inconsistent initial states, mixed actuator/passive multi-DoF joints, closure plus contact, long-horizon drift; dt refinement does not identify convergence order or alpha/integrator effects.

Only one guided sphere contact, fixed dt and budgets. Need resting/impact/sliding transitions, multiple contacts and simultaneous loops/limits, stiffness/mass-ratio variations, sparse_dynamics and preconditioning/linear-solver controlled studies, tolerance/budget sweeps and comparable-accuracy performance measurements.

Bounded PD remained unconverged at frozen tolerances. Need convergence/budget diagnosis without changing current acceptance, non-saturated tracking, unbounded PD, velocity mode, limit switching, prismatic/gimbal and mixed DoF routes.

Single-world consistent body-state reset only. Need multiworld masks, flags/callbacks, FK-failure reset, nontrivial contact/warmstart history, other warmstart modes, inconsistent external state and model-change lifecycle.
GPU/graphs, cross-device reproducibility, long-duration stability and published paper benchmark reproductions remain untested.
